title: Large Language Models Are Biased Because They Are Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper is a theoretical position paper and does not conduct benchmark measurements. It mentions 'antisemitism' once as a hypothetical example of a harmful bias.
findings: The paper does not analyze religion or faith. It mentions 'antisemitism' once as part of a list of harmful human biases (racism, misogyny, antisemitism) that society prioritizes countering, but provides no specific findings or analysis related to it or any other religious aspect.
